blocker.message: Canonical symbolic execution cannot parse the forward typedef `typedef struct cspace CSPACE;` because the QCP C frontend requires `struct cspace` to be declared or defined before that use. This fails before any annotation can be checked.
blocker.repair_boundary: The main agent must make the semantics-preserving source-level type-declaration rewrite `typedef struct cspace { ... } CSPACE;` (or another parser-supported equivalent). The annotation owner may then continue in this same persistent session and construct the function contract.
